description: This header defines a lock-free linked list for recording samples in profiling, including templates for Sample and SampleRecorder classes, with methods for registration, unregistration, iteration, and management of samples and their lifecycle.

classes.name: Sample
classes.description: Template struct representing a sample with linking members for a lock-free linked list, including a mutex for thread safety and a weight indicator.

classes.name: SampleRecorder
classes.description: Template class managing a lock-free linked list of samples, providing registration, unregistration, iteration, and sample lifecycle management.

methods.name: SampleRecorder()
methods.description: Constructor initializing the sample recorder, setting up the graveyard list.

methods.name: ~SampleRecorder()
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up all allocated samples.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a new sample, reusing dead samples if available, or creating new ones.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a sample, moving it to the dead list.

methods.name: SetDisposeCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback to be called on samples when they are unregistered.

methods.name: Iterate
methods.description: Iterates over all live samples, applying a provided function.

methods.name: GetMaxSamples
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of samples allowed.

methods.name: SetMaxSamples
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of samples.
